# Mohammed

> Robotics engineer in SLAM, navigation and computer vision, building on ROS 2 with C++ and Python and measuring every result. Based in Ethiopia,
> open to remote work.

- Focus areas: computer vision and perception (detection, tracking and target estimation for robots); SLAM and state estimation (LiDAR-inertial
  SLAM, pose-graph optimization, sensor fusion, 4+ years); robotics and robot learning (autonomous ground robots and drones in ROS 2 and simulation
  with Nav2, PX4 and Gazebo).
- Education: MSc in Artificial Intelligence at Addis Ababa University, in progress, with a thesis on robust pose-graph optimization; BSc in Computer
  Engineering, Eritrean Institute of Technology.
- Teaching: assistant lecturer in Electrical and Computer Engineering at Samara University since 2021; part-time robotics lecturer at Addis Ababa
  University since 2026.
- Freelance: robotics projects through Upwork.
